parsed.post: Kept the reduction in TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144, improving val_bpb to 0.8477. Despite the shard contamination concerns raised by others, the improvements are consistent. Next, I'll test increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if increasing model width follows the capacity gains seen with depth.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model width/capacity.
